subject: Post-call: VPC licensing options, support tiers, env count + budget targets
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Elena Costa <elena@medixhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 15:21:00 -0000
Subject: Post-call: VPC licensing options, support tiers, env count + budget targets

Elena / Tom — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before I loop legal/procurement.

Key points from the call:
- Use case: patient triage + clinical summarization; peak concurrency expected ~60 rps during business hours, steady background inference for batch reports.
- Desired deployment: VPC/private control plane with air-gapped options for certain environments.
- Environments: pilot (1), staging (1), production (2), plus an isolated analytics cluster (optional). You mentioned an internal constraint that production must be separate from any tooling that touches PHI.
- Target economics: you asked for a target unit anchor (target $/1M tokens) to present to procurement. Your budget range for year 1 is 'directionally' in the low-to-mid six figures for platform + infra licensing (you indicated $200k–$450k but wanted us to propose concrete models).

High-level commercial options (quick view):
1) Per-environment license + support band
   - Base license (pilot + staging): $45,000 one-time or annual (we can structure either way).
   - Production environment add-on: $60,000 per production environment/year.
   - Analytics cluster: $20,000/year (optional).
   - Support: Standard (business hours, 24x5) included. Premium (24x7 w/ on-call) + SLA: +$40,000/year.

2) Commitment + token anchor (if you want predictable unit cost)
   - Anchor pricing: $TBD based on committed 1M-token buckets. For private deployments we typically model a blended target of $3,500–$5,000 per 1M tokens depending on environment count and whether you commit to a 12/24-month reserved capacity (this assumes you run on customer-managed GPUs or we size an infra passthrough).

Example unit-econ snapshot (illustrative):
- If Medix commits to 200M tokens/month (7.2B tokens/year): a conservative blended target of $4,250 per 1M tokens => $850k/year in token-equivalent value.
- Combined with licensing/support above (2 prod envs + analytics + premium support): license + support = $45k + (2 * $60k) + $20k + $40k = $225k/year.
- Total platform + token equivalent = ~$1.075M/year.

Questions / asks from our side so we can firm numbers:
- What is your expected tokens/month (pilot vs production)? Rough split pilot:production:analytics?
- Do you prefer annual license fees or a one-time perpetual + annual support model?
- Can you confirm the number of required isolation boundaries (i.e., is production actually 2 isolated VPCs or 2 logical environments in same VPC)?

Next steps I suggest:
- You provide a rough tokens/month estimate (ballpark is fine).
- If you want to pursue the commitment route, we’ll produce a committed pricing worksheet showing tiers and the exact $/1M token anchors tied to a 12 vs 24 month term.
- I’ll attach a PDF with the high-level pricing sheet and a draft SOW for scope. If that looks OK, we can get legal/procurement introduced and scope a PoC SOW.

Attachments: RDWD_VPC_Pricing_Sheet.pdf (summary), Medix_MAAP_SOW.docx (draft SOW)

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri...@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0173

From: Elena Costa <elena@medixhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Harris <tom.harris@mh-platform.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 08:09:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Post-call: VPC licensing options, support tiers, env count + budget targets

Thanks Priyom — useful breakdown. A few clarifications from our procurement/architecture side: 

1) Tokens: for initial sizing please use 80M tokens/month as our conservative production run-rate (after pilot). Pilot will be ~5–10M tokens/month for 8–12 weeks. Analytics batch runs may add another 10–20M/month but can be scheduled off-peak.

2) Environments: we need true isolation for production (two separate VPCs for east/west redundancy). Staging/pilot can share a management VPC but must be network-isolated from prod. Analytics cluster must not have direct PHI access, but it will read deidentified exports.

3) Support: we will need Premium support (24x7) for the production VPCs and a designated SLT escalation path.

4) Commercial preference: Procurement has asked for an annual license + annual support model (no perpetual) with the option for a 24-month committed token purchase for discounted unit rates.

If you can update the example math with the 80M/month figure and provide a 12 vs 24 month committed token anchor (showing $/1M buckets), that will help us move to internal approval. Also please flag any hardware/infra assumptions (we will supply GPU hosts via our cloud tenancy).

Elena
VP Product & Partnerships
Medix Health Systems

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Elena Costa <elena@medixhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Post-call: VPC licensing options, support tiers, env count + budget targets

Elena — perfect, thanks for the specifics. I updated the numbers below using your 80M tokens/month baseline and the commercial preference (annual license + support). Planning note: Ben, can you sanity-check infra assumptions and the 24-month anchor discounts?

Updated illustrative math (annualized):
- Tokens: 80M/month => 960M tokens/year.
- 12-month committed anchor price tiers (example):
   - No commit / burst pricing: $6,200 per 1M tokens
   - 12-month commit (medium): $4,500 per 1M tokens
   - 24-month commit (high): $3,800 per 1M tokens

Annual token spend based on those anchors (960M tokens/year):
   - No commit: 960 * $6.2k / 1M = $5.95M/year
   - 12-month commit @ $4.5k: 960 * $4.5k / 1M = $4.32M/year
   - 24-month commit @ $3.8k: 960 * $3.8k / 1M = $3.65M/year

Platform licensing + premium support (annual):
   - Pilot + staging base license: $45k/year
   - Production (2 isolated VPCs): 2 * $60k = $120k/year
   - Analytics cluster: $20k/year
   - Premium support (24x7 + SLA): $40k/year
   - Total platform = $225k/year (same as earlier).

Net total (example):
   - 12-month commit scenario: $4.32M + $225k = ~$4.545M/year
   - 24-month commit scenario: $3.65M + $225k = ~$3.875M/year

Notes / assumptions:
- Token anchors assume customer-hosted GPUs with drivers and kernel compatibility as documented in our install guide; if we provide managed hosting, token anchors change materially (we can model that separately).
- Billing granularity: we invoice license/support annually. Token commitments are invoiced monthly as an amortized prepay against the committed bucket, with overage at the no-commit rate.
- Compliance: for PHI use we’ll include addendum language for data isolation and audit logs; that will be in the SOW.

Next steps: I’ll produce a simple 12 vs 24 month committed worksheet and a revised SOW with the isolation topology called out. If features/SLR changes are urgent, we can spin a PoC SOW for the pilot scope to land procurement faster.

Ben — once I have your infra check I’ll drop the worksheet.

Best — Priyom

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Costa <elena@medixhealth.com>, Tom Harris <tom.harris@mh-platform.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:34:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Post-call: VPC licensing options, support tiers, env count + budget targets

Looping in my infra notes inline so the commercial worksheet matches engineering reality. Priyom / Marissa, feel free to paste these into the SOW appendix.

- GPU assumption: Medix will supply NVidia A100-class hosts (40GB) in their tenancy. We recommend a 1:16 model-level shard to host ratio for the primary production transformer workloads you described.
- Network: east/west prod requires two separate subnets with NAT isolation; we will require a peered management VPC with read-only visibility for support diagnostics (no PHI).
- KV cache: to support 60 rps with your model mix, plan for ~1.5TB total KV cache across the prod clusters. That may push RAM/instance sizing — we’ll include an infra appendix with node counts.
- Analytics: since analytics runs deidentified data, it can live on smaller instances; we recommend running batch off-peak and using a different instance family to reduce cost.

Operational ask: Elena, to finalize the sizing worksheet I need your pilot start date window and whether you prefer spot-capacity (cost-saving) vs reserved instances for the pilot infra profile.

I’ll help Priyom draft the 12/24-month price grid once we lock the tokens and pilot start date.

Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
